77683.body:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** OpenAI stopped its own frontier training for the first time in its history, and the reasons are wild. Claude Cowork works on your phone, Cursor picked a fight with GitHub on GitHub's worst day in months and Google bought a dead airline's data for $10 million for AI training.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **OpenAI:** What scared it into stopping its own training?

* **Anthropic:** What's the catch in Cowork going mobile?

* **Cursor:** What did it launch hours before GitHub collapsed?

* **Google:** Why did it buy a dead airline's files?


----------



----------
## OpenAI stopped its own training for the first time ever

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6a160e89-a3be-411d-9b5e-fb84cce77e8a/ChatGPT_Image_Aug_19__2026__12_28_35_AM.png?t=1787089254)
Caption: 

OpenAI just did the one thing nobody expected from the fastest lab in the race. It stopped.

The company revealed Tuesday it [paused reinforcement learning](https://openai.com/index/pacing-model-development-cyber-capabilities/) on the models it plans to ship soon. That has never happened before.

So what spooked them. 

An unreleased model escaped its sandbox during an internal security test and broke into Hugging Face's real systems, and nobody caught it for about a week. 

Then early tests showed Astra, the next major model, may hit Critical on OpenAI's own cyber risk scale. No OpenAI model has ever gotten that far.

Sam Altman [told Time](https://time.com/article/2026/08/18/openai-slowing-training/) there was no single smoking gun, just misalignment showing up faster than researchers expected. In his words, it’s a good time to slow down.




----------

77682.subject: Nubank’s Q2 2026: the best-run bank on Earth, and the $1 billion quarter that wasn’t 🏦👀; Razorpay launches Vulca…
77682.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1115

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we're diving deep into Nubank's latest financials to see how the best-run bank on Earth just printed its first-ever $1 billion quarter - and why it was really an $896M quarter with a $165M tax break (breaking down the most important facts & figures from Nubank's Q2 2026, including the $500M buyback nobody mentioned & the AI flywheel incumbents can't copy, to see whether $NU is still worth your time & money + bonus guide on how to Turn Claude Opus 5 Into a Financial Analyst That Never Sleeps [ https://substack.com/redirect/d75525b8-14b2-441c-bfeb-7e534fbe1653?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Razorpay Vulcan, India's first AI foundation model built purely for payments (what a "shared brain" trained on 4 billion payments actually does, how Vulcan stacks up against Stripe, Nubank's nuFormer & Revolut's PRAGMA [ https://substack.com/redirect/89fc51e0-b5e5-4fba-9912-ae25f8ada6ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and why the real endgame is agentic commerce + bonus deep dives into How to Build an Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/8d3474c9-3572-4602-82bc-cbf6d992d5af?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & The Complete Guide to YC’s Open-Source AI Agent Harness [ https://substack.com/redirect/b59dab4f-0df4-46c0-a89c-82052521304e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Nubank’s Q2 2026: the best-run bank on Earth, and the $1 billion quarter that wasn’t 🏦👀
Earnings time 🤑 Latin America’s digital banking giant Nubank $NU  just reported the monster quarter everyone wanted - net income above $1 billion for the first time in its 13-year history ($1.06B, +49% FX-neutral), revenue up 39% to $5.9B, and return on equity at a record 33% - and the stock jumped 9.3% the next session. Nice!
This yet again proves that Nubank might be the best-run company in banking, and one of the best-run anywhere in the world 🏦
In a capital-intensive, heavily regulated industry, across emerging markets, it just posted a 19.5% efficiency ratio (Brazilian incumbents run in the 40s and 50s), a 33% ROE, and a cost to serve stuck near $1.00 per customer per month against $17.1 of ARPAC - with 10.4k employees covering 139M customers (~13,400 each, an order of magnitude above incumbents), ~80% of them historically acquired organically, and $45.3B of deposits priced below the risk-free rate.
Behind it sits a real flywheel: a decade of transaction data feeding NuFormer, the in-house AI model management says cut predicted risk ~70% versus prior generations, while headcount fell last quarter and revenue grew 50%. 77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
